Later, considering the use case scenario results, an economic analysis was performed to explore the cost-benefit of a MV SST with DC-to-DC converters as against a conventional distribution transformer with downstream AC-to-DC rectifier and DC-to-DC converters. Preliminary Analysis: A 1-minute timestep simulation was conducted. Voltage: The overall minimum and maximum voltages on the feeder through the simulation day is shown in Fig. 7. In scenario 1 with EV only, it was observed that even with the active regulators and capacitors’ controls, the minimum voltage goes beyond the ANSI limit of 0.95 per unit in the presence of high EV charging load. It’s clear that the low voltage beyond 0.95 occurred at the time of peak EV charging. On the other hand, in scenario 2, when SST was added instead of conventional transformers, the minimum voltages were maintained above 0.95 per unit.
